description: This file declares functions related to generating and reading fingerprint metadata for TensorFlow SavedModels, including creating fingerprint definitions, reading fingerprints from files, and generating canonical fingerprint IDs.
external_methods: std::string Singleprint(uint64_t graph_def_program_hash, uint64_t signature_def_hash, uint64_t saved_object_graph_hash, uint64_t checkpoint_hash)

classes.name: tensorflow::saved_model::fingerprinting
classes.description: Namespace encapsulating functions for fingerprinting SavedModels in TensorFlow.

methods.name: CreateFingerprintDef
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint definition protobuf for a SavedModel located in `export_dir`, possibly handling chunked models.

methods.name: ReadSavedModelFingerprint
methods.description: Reads the fingerprint protobuf (`fingerprint.pb`) from the specified `export_dir`.

methods.name: Singleprint
methods.description: Generates a canonical fingerprint string based on various hash components or an existing FingerprintDef.
